title: P0.71: Live UI Presence Contract + UIBridge Truthfulness + Human-Simulated Chat Audit
description: Codex audited IABV on Windows and found: (1) startup_bridge_reused does not guarantee UI is alive, (2) no port 18921 bridge before forcing UI, (3) duplicate python -m iabv_v15 app processes, (4) UIBridge send_message buffered without ControlCenterViewModel, (5) navigate reported success but route didn't change, (6) 'sigue' fell to provider=local with 112s stall, (7) FreezeIncidentReporter cause unknown. P0.71 addresses all seven root causes.
resume_hint: Tasks A-E implemented: start_iabv.ps1 presence contract, port conflict detection, UIBridge fail-closed, FreezeIncidentReporter bridge state capture, OSES _ui_bridge_truth_findings(). Task F tests: 24 P0.71 tests + 28 existing = 52/52 passing. Task G: live Windows proof pending.
next_action: User runs IABV on Windows, confirms exactly one UI process, one 18921 owner, sends '¿por dónde vamos?' through UIBridge, confirms response in chat, confirms runtime_audit has no stall >5s.

tasks_implemented: A: start_iabv.ps1 corrected — startup_bridge_reused not sufficient if -StartUI requested, added detection of existing UI process, port 18921 bridge verification, existing UI window focus, comprehensive traces
B: Single UI Instance Sovereignty — duplicate detection via Get-Process + CimInstance, port conflict check via _detect_port_owner(), SO_REUSEADDR cannot create double logical owner

C: UIBridge Truth Contract — get_ui_state exposes ui_process_pid/bridge_owner_pid/control_vm_bound/chat_ready, send_message fail-closed (status=unavailable when no VM), navigate verifies route changed
D: Human-Simulated Chat Audit — 4 simulation tests: bridge delivers messages to VM, navigate to control verified, chat_ready after bootstrap, no silent buffering without VM

E: Freeze Causal Diagnosis — FreezeIncidentReporter._capture_ui_bridge_state() captures bridge/VM binding at freeze time, OSES._ui_bridge_truth_findings() detects 4 patterns (bridge_claimed_ready_but_no_vm, local_chat_slow_after_continuity, ui_stall_without_causal_phase, duplicate_ui_bridge_owner)
